pr_summary: Fix infinite loop in Parquet column reader when reading corrupted files with zero repetition levels. The fix adds a check in the column reader's page iteration loop to detect when both records_read and levels_read are zero, and returns an error 'Insufficient repetition levels read from column' instead of looping indefinitely.
patch_file_cues: parquet/src/column/reader.rs - adds check for zero repetition levels to prevent infinite loop
test_file_cues: parquet/tests/arrow_reader/ - contains arrow reader integration tests

The project uses cargo as the package manager and has both Rust unit tests (cargo test) and Python integration tests (pytest with pyspark). The fix adds a safety check to prevent infinite loops when reading corrupted Parquet files.
